sentence: Stakeholder engagement built on AI reaches firm performance through marketing agility
passage: [Tehrani & Roy (2025), abstract] "The results indicate that engaging stakeholders through AI technologies positively influences marketing agility, which in turn enhances firm performance. These effects are amplified in conditions of high technology turbulence."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states the causal chain that engaging stakeholders through AI positively influences marketing agility, which in turn enhances firm performance.
